author: Fouled
body:
Hey! I'm here to discuss the recent map submissions that look very a-like to the map, Gladiator. There are enough of those types of maps, and there doesn't really need to be more. The game-play would be very similar, repetitive and wouldn't be very funny if the same types of map styles occur throughout the rotations. I've also discussed this with other mapdevs, and we had the same answer. Try to make TDM maps more unique and creative! Try to use different map styles.
Thanks & have a nice day! :)

title: Attention - TDM maps.

replies.author: Robin_DD_J
replies.body:
In my opinion there are some issues the with current map "Gladiator". No offence to the creator.

-What's the point being able to build upwards when you cant shoot down people? (Just add a bridge or something from spawn to the island so you won't need blocks for that)
- Almost the same as that one ^. But should you really be able to make bridges to eachothers spawns? It does count as spawnkilling, doesn't it? 

Thought I would come up with a lot of stuff in this post, but I'm tired and can't be asked to write it all down :/ (Thought I would bring this up now when we are talking about the "tdm" maps)
